description: มุน 2026-07-30 (ดวงสมพงศ์ Slice 1 UI, composes goo's useCompatibility): V3 compatibility screen (Figma 480:4549/636:18451) + V3-native friend-select window + add-friend sheet (636:18533). (b) BROKEN 2-STATE gate — button not gated on canViewResult. (c) DEAD placeholders / hidden-instead-of-disabled connect rows. V3-NATIVE select (ฟีม ruling): the friend list is built new in the sheet's V3 language reading MemberWithFriendGetApi — NOT the v1 modal mounted; ZERO edits to pages/matching or api-user-matching (v1 reused via goo's wrap). DELIBERATE Figma divergences (ฟีม-ordered, like ซินแส): 3 typos corrected (สมพงค์→สมพงศ์ · ความความรัก→ความรัก · เพียงเเค่→เพียงแค่); gender selector restored from v1 (REFRAME 3); friend-list added (node 636:17802 has none — ฟีม 'เพิ่มสิ่งที่ต้องมี'); surname sent '' (gap); image-upload affordance rendered but file→URL deferred (imageProfile ''). Tooth: mut-silent-male (hardcode gender MALE ignoring the pick → request shows MALE though user chose FEMALE → CAUGHT). gate is defense-in-depth (native disabled + aria + gray + onClick guard). gate_layer=visual/compat-presentation+gender-reaches-api+state-gate.
